Tuesday 25 August 2026 - Ordinary Council Meeting

Tuesday, August 25, 2026 - 05:30 PM

CHANGES TO COUNCIL AND COMMITTEE MEETING DETAILS

In accordance with section 5.25(1)(g) of the Local Government Act 1995 and regulation 12(3) of the Local Government (Administration) Regulations 1996, the Shire of Carnarvon advises that Council has approved at the 28 July 2026 Ordinary Meeting of Council, amendments to the following meeting:

 

Ordinary Council Meetings
Council has approved a trial change to the commencement time of Ordinary Council Meetings from 10.00am to 5.30pm for the following meetings:

Tuesday, 25 August 2026
5.30pm
Shire of Carnarvon Council Chambers, 3 Francis Street, Carnarvon WA 6701

For further information, including meeting agendas and minutes, please visit www.carnarvon.wa.gov.au or contact us on 08 9941 0000.

 

Amanda Dexter
CHIEF EXECUTIVE OFFICER

RESCHEDULED - Tuesday 30 June 2026 - Ordinary Council Meeting

Tuesday, June 30, 2026 - 02:00 PM

In accordance with section 5.25(1)(g) of the Local Government Act 1995 and regulation 12(3) of the Local Government (Administration) Regulations 1996, the Shire of Carnarvon advises that, pursuant to Council Resolution SCM 03/06/2026, the Ordinary Council Meeting originally scheduled for Tuesday, 23 June 2026 has been rescheduled to 30 June 2026 at 2pm.

CANCELLED - Thursday 28 May 2026 - Ordinary Council Meeting

Thursday, May 28, 2026 - 12:00 PM

In accordance with Regulation 12(3) of the Local Government (Administration) Regulations 1996, notice is given that the Ordinary Council Meeting scheduled for Thursday, 28 May 2026, to be held in Coral Bay, has been cancelled.

Any rescheduled meeting dates will be provided as soon as practicable, pending further advice from the Department of Local Government, Industry Regulation and Safety (LGIRS).
